description:
Filed s520 by s519a while probing ruling 3 (found, not caused: identical on an fca3593b extraction).  Pl::Parser's leading-local machinery reads only the FIRST subscript of a chain:
  our %rm = (R => { a => 1, c => 3 });
  { local $rm{R}{c} = 9; print "$rm{R}{c}\n"; }    # perl 9, PCL "" (it localizes $rm{R} itself and sets it to 9)
  print "$rm{R}{c}\n";                              # perl 3, PCL 3
  my $x = { a => 1, b => 2, c => 3 }; my @hc = qw(a b);
  { local $x->@{@hc}; print join(",", map { $_ // "u" } @$x{qw(a b c)}), "\n"; }   # perl u,u,3, PCL u,u,u
`local $rm{R}->{c} = 9` is the same miss.  SILENT WRONG.  The fix belongs in _process_local_declaration's subscript arms (Symbol + Subscript, Symbol + -> + Subscript, and the s520 Cast + Subscript arm): the container is everything up to the LAST subscript, evaluated as an ordinary expression (the `(unbox BASE)` the arrow arm uses), and the postfix `->@{...}` / `->@[...]` spellings are a slice of the referent (p-local-hash-slice / p-local-array-slice).

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- every row (silent): `{ local $rm{R}{c} = 9; print $rm{R}{c} }` perl 9 PCL "" (restored 3 in both) ; `local $rm{R}->{c} = 8`
  perl 8 PCL "" ; `{ local $x->@{@hc}; ... @$x{qw(a b c)} }` perl u,u,3 PCL u,u,u (restored 1,2,3 in both).
LABEL: silent (subject now says so).


=== DONE (s543g) ===
Opus 5.5, 2026-11-22.  Pl::Stmt::local_expr_elem_base reads a target that ENDS in a subscript and is not one of the three one-level bases: the element is the LAST subscript, the container the run before it (a `->` dropped), lowered ONCE as an ordinary expression by Parser2::_local_expr_container (an element container takes the plain read's p-viv-container / -array- mark, so it VIVIFIES; any other container is a reference value through the cast form) and bound to a temporary after the right side, before the localization.  ONE reading for the single statement (_local_plan_elem), the `local (...)` list (_local_target_item, which dropped the shape) and `delete local` (_local_plan_delete).  The one-level spellings emit byte for byte as before.  The postfix slice `$r->@{...}` / `$r->@[...]` (and `$h{a}->@{...}`) is the slice of the referent, localized one element at a time (p-local-hash-slice / p-local-array-slice): scratch/s543g/probes (the s543g worktree)/m2 11 shapes (key list from an array, an empty list, a duplicate key, new keys, vivification) tree = perl (base 2).  `local %h{...}` is perl's compile error (rule 9).  Guard Pl/t/local-elem-02.t M4.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `local $h{a}{b} = V` (a multi-level chain), `local $rm{R}->{c} = V` and `local $r->@{...}` (a postfix slice) localize the wrong slot -- the inner element reads empty inside the scope (one family with #540 #1190)
